title: Timeless Art
description: This mod adds more painting to minecraft
body:
Bring the world of art into Minecraft! 🎨

This mod adds a rich collection of famous real-world paintings alongside random artwork, giving every build a unique and creative touch. From timeless masterpieces to unexpected abstract designs, each painting can transform your walls into a true gallery.

Features:

🖼️ Famous paintings inspired by real-world masterpieces

🎲 Random art for endless variety
